name: Leon Durandal
original_name: レオン=デュランダール
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Image Stone: Garnet, Inca Rose

A Holy Knight whose specialty is fire magic.
An inflexible guy who feels unsettled when things aren't clearly one thing or another, but he can be helpful at times.
He's like a leader to the knight troupe and always strives to be a knight that can purely protect his country and people.
